english.title: PSV operator use a vehicle on a road for carriage of passengers for hire / reward other than under an operators licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a public service vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), used the vehicle on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), for carrying passengers for hire or reward other than under a P.S.V Operator's Licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(5) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) Further detail may be included in the Statement of Facts in relation to the use of the vehicle on the occasion in question (e.g. the journey, number of passengers etc.) and any explanation given by the defendant.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant who was the operator of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), a public service vehicle, used it on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) to carry passengers for hire or reward without an operator's licence.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket - Three hundred pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
